summary: Dispute over development rights income; whether stock in trade (business) vs capital asset; AO assessed Rs.15.94 Crore as capital gains; ITAT held transaction part of inventory/business, income already declared in prior year; Revenue challenged ITAT order, claiming perverse; High Court dismissed Revenue's appeal; Supreme Court examined ledger entries (Rs.15.94 Cr receipt/recording), rectification deed reducing value to Rs.5.24 Cr, refund claims, business nature evidence; issue: income characterization and year of recognition.
